Game Overview

At its heart, Ash Hidden Objects is a hidden object game about join the amusing Ash and Pikachu on a treasure hunt to uncover hidden objects. Sharpen your concentration, race against the clock, and aim for top scores in this delightful fan challenge. Can you achieve three stars in every level before time runs out?

Ash Hidden Objects keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Join the amusing Ash and Pikachu on a treasure hunt to uncover hidden objects.
